name: pi-openai-stt
description: STT provider for any OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Implements the SttProvider contract from pi-telegram-echo; registers with id 'pi-openai-stt'. Talks POST /v1/audio/transcriptions. Env vars: OPENAI_STT_BASE_URL (default https://api.openai.com/v1), OPENAI_API_KEY (optional; only sent when set), OPENAI_STT_MODEL (default whisper-1), PI_TELEGRAM_LANG (default yue).
